title: Cold-start penalty mitigation and customer-bridging hotfix
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary:
During a high-severity customer escalation, a pattern of 5xx spikes and elevated tail latency was traced to repeated cold-start penalties and request retry amplification for a subset of tenants. Symptoms: chains of retries from client SDKs combined with server cold starts triggered KV cache compaction and increased GPU kernel warm-up times, producing transient 5xx and timeouts for affected tenants.

Root cause hypothesis (evidence collected):
- Edge to runtime handoff for cold workers has a 2–6s initialization path that is sensitive to request concurrency; under tenant bursts this leads to running out of warm slots and queuing.
- Upstream SDKs are configured with aggressive exponential backoff but short initial timeouts; when facing a cold start they retry quickly and create a retry storm that circumvents tenant admission controls.
- KV cache eviction and compaction is triggered under memory pressure caused by simultaneous warmups; compaction operations block quick resume paths, lengthening timeouts and causing 502/504s.
- Lack of tenant-level request dampening and missing per-tenant long-tail metrics delayed detection.

Mitigation objectives (short-term):
1) Stabilize customer traffic within 4 hours and prevent immediate 5xx recurrence.
2) Provide a minimal-impact patch to reduce cold-start cost and stop retry amplification.
3) Communicate clear interim guidance to impacted customers and solutions engineers.

Immediate tactical plan (implemented / in flight):
- Deploy hotpatch v0.1 to runtime-edge that: (a) enforces a soft admission cap per-tenant that returns 429 for excessive concurrent requests rather than triggering cold worker allocation, (b) adds an early fast-fail path for KV compaction if latency would exceed threshold. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4712
- Push SDK advisory and temporary recommended config to docs + notify top-affected customers: recommend increasing initial timeout to 6s and staggered retry jitter. Advisory doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/hosted/cold-start-advisory-2026-03
- Enable per-tenant long-tail alerting dashboard (short-window P95/P99) and a synthetic probe that simulates tenant burst. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/hosted/coldstart-bridging

Longer-term engineering work (follow-ups):
- Implement warm slot reservation and predictive pre-warm heuristics for tenants with bursty profiles (design doc in Confluence).
- Add server-side idempotency token validation and de-duplication layer for create/ mutate flows to reduce cost of retries.
- Rework KV compaction to be background-friendly with non-blocking read path.
- Align SDK default retry semantics with admission control signals (backoff on 429/503 distinctions).

Customer communication plan:
- Sent immediate incident update to affected accounts and assigned Solutions contact for one-to-one bridging.
- Follow-up postmortem and remediation ETA promised within 72 hours.

Acceptance criteria for closing this ticket:
- Hotpatch v0.1 rolled to 100% with metrics showing >90% reduction in tenant-exposed 5xx spikes for affected group across a 6-hour window.
- SDK advisory acknowledged by top 5 customers and we have at least 3 customers who applied the recommended timeout change.
- Follow-up engineering RFC for warm slot and non-blocking compaction filed and scheduled into a milestone.
